title: Executable Vandermonde matrix
statement: Let an executable Vandermonde input have independence order $k$ and output dimension $n$, and put $\ell=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$. The matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$ has $(k-1)\ell+1$ rows and $n$ columns: its row indexed by the constant component consists of ones, while a row indexed by $(q,i)$ has, in column $j$, the $i$th coefficient of the reduction modulo the chosen irreducible polynomial of the $(q+1)$st power of the point associated with $j$.
hypotheses_covered: Input has an independence order $k$ with $1\le k\le n$
